description: Election Commission - K. T. D. A. Sisira kumara elected as Vice Chairman of the Dompe Pradeshiya Sabaha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for the office of Vice Chairman of a local authority (Dompe Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with an electoral process at the local government level, including the nomination and declaration of an elected official, which falls under the Elections classification (Type 7).
